records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Your workspace for River Dynamics is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Following up on my earlier notes — I know a new workspace is easy to put aside in a busy week.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is usually what makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to set up that first project with you live, or answer questions by email if that's easier.

Best,
Chidi
